sources.label: Official Arc'teryx Men's Sizing Chart, Jacket/shirt ('Your body measurements in centimetres') and International tab

audit: Old /gb/en/size-guide 404s; guide is /gb/en/help/sizing (Men's chart at /help/sizing/mens). Jacket/shirt chart, cm, 'Your body measurements', XXS-XXXL; UK and Europe from its International tab. M 94/80 -> 102/86 (UK 38, EU 48); XL 106/92 -> 119/104 (UK 46, EU 56); XXL 112/98 -> 129/114. XXS, XXXL and hips added; US removed (not printed). Page notes men's fit was revised: smaller sizes tighter, larger looser.
